1034/laerta/solanta/1.label: About 16 years before the novel
1034/laerta/solanta/1.t: The channel chart: Carlos el Niña buys a chart of the approach to Solanta from a Black sailor and plans the expedition with Maduro.

1003/solanta/solanta/2.label: About 16 years before the novel
1003/solanta/solanta/2.t: The Solantian Expedition: the schooner Santa Eliza takes a coastal fort in Solanta, and the doge signs a treaty of alliance.

1034/solanta/solanta/3.label: About 16 years before the novel
1034/solanta/solanta/3.t: The navigator is handed over: the doge demands the man who knows the channel. Carlos hands over Rodrigo da Vira, whom the doge sells into slavery.

1022/laerta/solanta/4.label: Three months later
1022/laerta/solanta/4.t: A posthumous decoration: Carlos and Fatima win their case against the High Table, and the supposedly dead navigator da Vira is awarded the Order of Courage.

1022/laerta/solanta/5.label: Later
1022/laerta/solanta/5.t: Carmencita Estevos’s lawsuit: the obrera Shadow asks the court to recognize her as da Vira’s widow and her infant as his son. The court refuses.

1004/dunkvald/dangar/1.label: Ch. 4
1004/dunkvald/dangar/1.t: A Catalian in the mycelium: Red is brought in bonds to the forest camp of enslaved diggers. Joriksen promises freedom in return for a schönbrun.

1012/dunkvald/dangar/2.label: Ch. 12
1012/dunkvald/dangar/2.t: A prize instead of freedom: water appears at the thirteenth yard, but Red is taken to Greta instead, and he flees into the forest.

1015/dunkvald/dangar/3.label: Ch. 15
1015/dunkvald/dangar/3.t: The schönbrun recipe: Yakka brings back the fugitive; the letter goes to Laerta, and Red sings as he digs at night.

1019/dunkvald/dangar/4.label: Ch. 19
1019/dunkvald/dangar/4.t: Buried alive: Red’s cough goes away, and the foreman buries him in the pit.

1023/dunkvald/dangar/5.label: Ch. 23
1023/dunkvald/dangar/5.t: No sarcoma: Baron Landau declares that the schönbrun has cured Red.

1027/dunkvald/dangar/6.label: Ch. 27
1027/dunkvald/dangar/6.t: Täuschung: Klein reveals the deception, Red slaughters people on the road, and Landau seizes him with an unknown power.

1033/dunkvald/dangar/7.label: Ch. 33
1033/dunkvald/dangar/7.t: A beast in the pit: years of executions under the Zustand, the “THOU SHALT NOT KILL” brand, and Greta’s death. Red is taken into the army.

1033/ollandiya/war/2.label: Before ch. 2
1033/ollandiya/war/2.t: Neubiy: in the army, Red becomes a “stone” rifleman in a platoon attached to Dietrich’s battery.

1002/ollandiya/war/3.label: Ch. 2
1002/ollandiya/war/3.t: The battle at the well on the hill.

1031/latsen/war/6.label: Ch. 31
1031/latsen/war/6.t: Dietrich’s arrest: Klein finds a body in the well by the railway halt but backs down before the Lourds and the Eyrings.

1028/ollandiya/war/7.label: Six months before ch. 28
1028/ollandiya/war/7.t: Ollandia capitulates: the war is over.

1032/tres-molinos/before/1.label: Before ch. 1
1032/tres-molinos/before/1.t: Six Dangarians: van Halm hires servants from the Empire. The eldest speaks Catalian well and has letters branded below his collarbone.

1032/tres-molinos/before/2.label: Before ch. 1
1032/tres-molinos/before/2.t: Five at Last Winter: the heroes of Solanta visit van Halm.

1034/tres-molinos/before/3.label: Before ch. 1
1034/tres-molinos/before/3.t: A letter to Carlos: da Vira writes that he has already taken revenge. A chart of the channel to Solanta is drawn on the back.

1003/laerta/novel/2.label: Ch. 3
1003/laerta/novel/2.t: A book commission: Filippe di Berro asks Alvaro to write about what has become of the heroes of Solanta.

1022/laerta/novel/4.label: Ch. 22
1022/laerta/novel/4.t: The Scroll’s archive: Alvaro and Beatriz find the navigator da Vira’s file.

1032/tres-molinos/novel/5.label: Ch. 32
1032/tres-molinos/novel/5.t: A thousand curses: Alvaro and Fernan go to Tres Molinos and inspect the House Above.
